faqs.q: What can I use GEX Options for?
faqs.a: Use it to map important options levels, watch price reactions, identify the next condition at a wall, and review setup boundaries. Add volatility, dealer exposure and contract scenarios to your research in the same workspace.

On-screen setup alerts follow your saved symbols while the site is open. New qualifying setups include their recorded entry area, five-minute invalidation boundary and reference target. The bell keeps today’s received alerts in this browser. Sound and wall-testing alerts are optional.

faqs.q: How current is the intraday data?
faqs.a: Intraday prices are delayed at least 15 minutes and views update periodically during market hours. Wall tracking uses completed five-minute price observations and near-term 1W expirations. Recorded times are visible so you can compare the assessment with current conditions.
Explore supported US-listed optionable stocks and ETFs, including SPY, QQQ and TSLA. Search for symbols and save the ones you follow in your watchlist.
The current {trial_days}-day trial begins after checkout is completed. The Pricing page shows the current billing choices and terms before you continue.

faqs.q: Can I cancel before the trial ends?
faqs.a: Yes. Open the billing portal from your account to cancel before the trial ends and avoid a subscription charge. Otherwise, your selected monthly or yearly subscription starts and renews automatically.

No. The platform provides analytics and modeled scenarios, not a guarantee that a level will hold or a target will be reached. A recorded setup describes conditions at its displayed time. Review current price and your own risk before making a decision.

faqs.a: Save the symbols you trade, then open Scanner’s Wall activity view. Choose a symbol to open its wall chart and matching assessment. Use EOD wall analysis to prepare your levels before the next session.

faqs.q: What does a setup with conditions met mean?
faqs.a: The recorded price sequence, entry area and target room passed the platform’s rules at the displayed delayed close. It does not mean the same entry remains available now or that the outcome is guaranteed.

faqs.q: Do alerts arrive when the site is closed?
faqs.a: No. These are in-app notifications while the site is open. Setup alerts are on by default and sound is optional. Today’s received alerts remain in the browser’s Recent alerts panel until midnight Eastern time.

The model changes price and time while prior-session open interest and reference IV stay fixed within each comparison window. Walls use the near-term 1W expiry scope. Intraday prices are delayed at least 15 minutes.

faqs.q: What is included in the subscription?
faqs.a: The full workspace: wall analysis, wall tracking, setup alerts, Scanner, gamma and dealer exposure, volatility and skew, strike and expiry views, unusual activity, the long-call and long-put calculator, and AI Export. Monthly and yearly billing include the same features.

Yes. Download selected datasets as structured JSON through AI Export. Wall timelines and intraday IV and skew also have their own JSON exports, and supported strike charts can be downloaded as PNG images.
